messages.subject: [FLR-list] a4a 'SCA'
messages.body_plain:
Folks,
I was wondering if anyone had experience of basic package error with Fla4a
when using the SCA family of functions. I think this might relate to a
32bit vs 64 bit compile?? but I'm not sure. I'm using FLcore
(2.6.0.020161214) and Fla4a (1.0.0) in R.3.3.2 on 32bit Unbuntu 16.04.

Some functions in the Fla4a run but with SCA I return errors. Any hints on
where I might solve this would be greatly appreciated.

Thanks
Mat
